041/**
042 * CalculationData is used to take the information for an
043 * {@link net.tnemc.core.currency.item.ItemCurrency} and break it down in order to perform
044 * Item-based calculations.
045 *
046 * @author creatorfromhell
047 * @since 0.1.2.0
048 */
049public class CalculationData<I> {
050
051  private final Map<BigDecimal, Integer> inventoryMaterials = new HashMap<>();
052
053  //Our Calculator
054  private final MonetaryCalculation calculator = new MonetaryCalculation();
055
056  private final I inventory;
057  private final ItemCurrency currency;
058  private final UUID player;
059  private boolean dropped = false;
060  private boolean failedDrop = false;
061
062  public CalculationData(final ItemCurrency currency, final I inventory, final UUID player) {
063
064    this.currency = currency;
065    this.inventory = inventory;
066    this.player = player;
067
068    inventoryCounts();
069  }
070
071  public Map<BigDecimal, Integer> getInventoryMaterials() {
072
073    return inventoryMaterials;
074  }
075
076  public TreeMap<BigDecimal, Denomination> getDenominations() {
077
078    return currency.getDenominations();
079  }
080
081  public MonetaryCalculation getCalculator() {
082
083    return calculator;
084  }
085
086  public ItemCurrency getCurrency() {
087
088    return currency;
089  }
090
091  public void inventoryCounts() {
092
093    for(final Map.Entry<BigDecimal, Denomination> entry : currency.getDenominations().entrySet()) {
094      if(entry.getValue() instanceof final ItemDenomination denomination) {
095
096        final AbstractItemStack<?> stack = TNECore.instance().denominationToStack(denomination);
097        final int count = PluginCore.server().calculations().count((AbstractItemStack<Object>)stack, inventory, currency.shulker(), currency.bundle());
098
099        if(count > 0) {
100          inventoryMaterials.put(entry.getKey(), count);
101        }
102      }
103    }
104  }
105
106  public void removeMaterials(final Denomination denomination, final Integer amount) {
107
108    final AbstractItemStack<?> stack = TNECore.instance().denominationToStack((ItemDenomination)denomination);
109    final int contains = inventoryMaterials.getOrDefault(denomination.weight(), 0);
110
111    if(contains == amount) {
112      inventoryMaterials.remove(denomination.weight());
113      PluginCore.log().debug("CalculationData - removeMaterials - equals: Everything equals, remove all materials. Weight: " + denomination.weight(), DebugLevel.DEVELOPER);
114      PluginCore.server().calculations().removeAll((AbstractItemStack<Object>)stack, inventory, currency.shulker(), currency.bundle());
115      return;
116    }
117
118    final int left = contains - amount;
119    PluginCore.log().debug("CalculationData - removeMaterials - left: " + left + "Weight: " + denomination.weight(), DebugLevel.DEVELOPER);
120    inventoryMaterials.put(denomination.weight(), left);
121    final AbstractItemStack<?> stackClone = stack.amount(amount);
122    PluginCore.server().calculations().removeItem((AbstractItemStack<Object>)stackClone, inventory, currency.shulker(), currency.bundle());
123  }
124
125  public void provideMaterials(final Denomination denomination, final Integer amount) {
126
127    int contains = (inventoryMaterials.getOrDefault(denomination.weight(), 0)) + amount;
128
129    PluginCore.log().debug("ProvideMaterials start. player=" + player
130                             + " denomWeight=" + denomination.weight()
131                             + " addAmount=" + amount
132                             + " trackedContainsBeforeInsert=" + contains
133                             + " enderFill=" + currency.isEnderFill()
134                             + " shulker=" + currency.shulker()
135                             + " bundle=" + currency.bundle(),
136                           DebugLevel.DEVELOPER);
137
138    final AbstractItemStack<?> stack = TNECore.instance().denominationToStack((ItemDenomination)denomination).amount(amount);
139    final Collection<AbstractItemStack<Object>> left = giveItemsRetry(Collections.singletonList((AbstractItemStack<Object>)stack), inventory);
140
141    PluginCore.log().debug("ProvideMaterials after primary inventory give. player=" + player
142                             + " leftStacks=" + left.size()
143                             + " leftAmount=" + countAmount(left),
144                           DebugLevel.DEVELOPER);
145
146
147    final Optional<PlayerAccount> account = TNECore.eco().account().findPlayerAccount(player);
148    if(!left.isEmpty() && account.isPresent()) {
149
150      if(currency.isEnderFill()) {
151
152        //PluginCore.log().debug("Ender Fill: " + contains, DebugLevel.DETAILED);
153        //PluginCore.log().debug("Ender Fill: " + amount, DebugLevel.DETAILED);
154        final Collection<AbstractItemStack<Object>> enderLeft = giveItemsRetry(left, account.get().getPlayer().get().inventory().getInventory(true));
155
156        PluginCore.log().debug("ProvideMaterials after ender fill attempt. player=" + player
157                                 + " enderLeftStacks=" + enderLeft.size()
158                                 + " enderLeftAmount=" + countAmount(enderLeft),
159                               DebugLevel.DEVELOPER);
160
161        if(!enderLeft.isEmpty()) {
162          PluginCore.log().debug("ProvideMaterials ender fill unresolved, attempting drop. player=" + player
163                                   + " dropAmount=" + countAmount(enderLeft),
164                                 DebugLevel.DEVELOPER);
165          drop(enderLeft, account.get());
166          if(!isFailedDrop()) {
167
168            contains = contains - countAmount(enderLeft);
169            PluginCore.log().debug("ProvideMaterials drop succeeded after ender fill. player=" + player
170                                     + " newTrackedContains=" + contains,
171                                   DebugLevel.DEVELOPER);
172          } else {
173            PluginCore.log().debug("ProvideMaterials drop failed after ender fill. player=" + player
174                                     + " trackedContainsUnchanged=" + contains,
175                                   DebugLevel.DEVELOPER);
176          }
177        } else {
178
179          contains = contains - countAmount(left);
180
181          PluginCore.log().debug("ProvideMaterials ender fill fully succeeded. player=" + player
182                                   + " movedAmount=" + countAmount(left)
183                                   + " newTrackedContains=" + contains,
184                                 DebugLevel.DEVELOPER);
185
186          final MessageData messageData = new MessageData("Messages.Money.EnderChest");
187          account.get().getPlayer().ifPresent(player->player.message(messageData));
188        }
189      } else {
190        PluginCore.log().debug("ProvideMaterials enderFill disabled, attempting drop from primary leftovers. player=" + player
191                                 + " dropAmount=" + countAmount(left),
192                               DebugLevel.DEVELOPER);
193        drop(left, account.get());
194        if(!isFailedDrop()) {
195
196          contains = contains - countAmount(left);
197          PluginCore.log().debug("ProvideMaterials drop succeeded from primary leftovers. player=" + player
198                                   + " newTrackedContains=" + contains,
199                                 DebugLevel.DEVELOPER);
200        } else {
201          PluginCore.log().debug("ProvideMaterials drop failed from primary leftovers. player=" + player
202                                   + " trackedContainsUnchanged=" + contains,
203                                 DebugLevel.DEVELOPER);
204        }
205      }
206    } else if(!left.isEmpty()) {
207      PluginCore.log().debug("ProvideMaterials has leftovers but no account present. player=" + player
208                               + " leftAmount=" + countAmount(left)
209                               + " trackedContainsUnchanged=" + contains,
210                             DebugLevel.DEVELOPER);
211    }
212
213    //PluginCore.log().debug("Weight: " + denomination.weight() + " - Amount: " + amount, DebugLevel.DETAILED);
214
215    inventoryMaterials.put(denomination.weight(), contains);
216
217    PluginCore.log().debug("ProvideMaterials complete. player=" + player
218                             + " denomWeight=" + denomination.weight()
219                             + " finalTrackedContains=" + contains,
220                           DebugLevel.DEVELOPER);
221  }
222
223  private <T> Collection<AbstractItemStack<Object>> giveItemsRetry(final Collection<AbstractItemStack<Object>> toGive, final T targetInventory) {
224
225    Collection<AbstractItemStack<Object>> left = PluginCore.server().calculations().giveItems(toGive,
226                                                                                               targetInventory,
227                                                                                               currency.shulker(),
228                                                                                               currency.bundle());
229
230    PluginCore.log().debug("giveItemsRetry initial give. player=" + player
231                             + " requestedStacks=" + toGive.size()
232                             + " requestedAmount=" + countAmount(toGive)
233                             + " leftStacks=" + left.size()
234                             + " leftAmount=" + countAmount(left),
235                           DebugLevel.DEVELOPER);
236
237    if(left.isEmpty() || !currency.shulker()) {
238      if(!currency.shulker() && !left.isEmpty()) {
239        PluginCore.log().debug("giveItemsRetry skipping container pass because shulker support is disabled. player=" + player
240                                 + " leftAmount=" + countAmount(left),
241                               DebugLevel.DEVELOPER);
242      }
243      return left;
244    }
245
246    PluginCore.log().debug("Container pass start. Leftover=" + countAmount(left)
247                             + " target=" + ((targetInventory == null)? "null" : targetInventory.getClass().getSimpleName()),
248                           DebugLevel.DEVELOPER);
249
250    final Collection<AbstractItemStack<Object>> remaining = ((ItemCalculations<Object>)TNECore.instance().itemCalculations()).tryInsertIntoContainers(left,
251                                                                                                       targetInventory,
252                                                                                                       currency);
253
254    if(remaining.isEmpty()) {
255      PluginCore.log().debug("Container pass inserted all leftovers.", DebugLevel.DEVELOPER);
256    } else {
257      PluginCore.log().debug("Container pass remaining after insert=" + countAmount(remaining)
258                               + " stacks=" + remaining.size(), DebugLevel.DEVELOPER);
259    }
260
261    return remaining;
262  }
263
264  public void drop(final Collection<AbstractItemStack<Object>> toDrop, final PlayerAccount account) {
265
266    failedDrop = false;
267
268    PluginCore.log().debug("Drop start. player=" + player
269                             + " stacks=" + toDrop.size()
270                             + " amount=" + countAmount(toDrop),
271                           DebugLevel.DEVELOPER);
272
273    final CurrencyDropCallback currencyDrop = new CurrencyDropCallback(player, currency, toDrop);
274    if(PluginCore.callbacks().call(currencyDrop)) {
275      PluginCore.log().error("Cancelled currency drop through callback.", DebugLevel.STANDARD);
276      failedDrop = true;
277      PluginCore.log().debug("Drop cancelled by callback. player=" + player, DebugLevel.DEVELOPER);
278      return;
279    }
280
281    failedDrop = PluginCore.server().calculations().drop(toDrop, player, true);
282    PluginCore.log().debug("Drop result. player=" + player + " failedDrop=" + failedDrop, DebugLevel.DEVELOPER);
283    if(!failedDrop) {
284
285      final MessageData messageData = new MessageData("Messages.Money.Dropped");
286      account.getPlayer().ifPresent(player->player.message(messageData));
287
288      dropped = true;
289    }
290  }
291
292  private int countAmount(final Collection<AbstractItemStack<Object>> stacks) {
293
294    return stacks.stream().mapToInt(AbstractItemStack::amount).sum();
295  }
296
297  public boolean isDropped() {
298
299    return dropped;
300  }
301
302  public boolean isFailedDrop() {
303
304    return failedDrop;
305  }
306}
